# appsignal_log_trigger (Resource)

A log trigger in an AppSignal app: it opens a log incident when incoming lines match a query.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_log_trigger" "import_errors" {
  app_id                 = appsignal_app.web.id
  name                   = "Import errors"
  query                  = "severity:error"
  source_ids             = [appsignal_log_source.workers.id]
  notifier_ids           = [data.appsignal_notifier.email.id]
  notification_frequency = "nth_in_hour"
  notification_threshold = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `query` (String) Log query in AppSignal's query syntax. AppSignal does not validate it, so check it in the log viewer first.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `notification_frequency` (String) When to notify: always, never, first_in_deploy, first_after_close, nth_in_hour, nth_in_day. Defaults to `always`.
- `notification_threshold` (Number) N for the `nth_in_hour` and `nth_in_day` frequencies. Defaults to 1.
- `notifier_ids` (Set of String) Notifiers alerted for new incidents. See the appsignal_notifier data source.
- `source_ids` (Set of String) Log sources the trigger watches. Empty means every source of the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_log_trigger.import_errors <app_id>/<log_trigger_id>
```
